hero.title: Boot screen themes
hero.description: Choose, preview, install and remove the Plymouth themes of Soplos Linux.

about.tagline: Plymouth boot splash theme manager for Soplos Linux.

themes.emptyBody: No Plymouth themes were found in the usual folders. Install the plymouth package or a theme to see them here.
themes.textOnlyBody: This theme only writes text and cannot be previewed in a window.
themes.removeBody: Delete the theme {name}? This cannot be undone.
themes.removeManyBody: Delete the {count} selected themes? This cannot be undone.
themes.removeSkipped: The theme in use is left out: it cannot be removed.
themes.removeActive: The theme in use cannot be removed. Apply another one first.

steps.noInitramfs: No initramfs tool was found (dracut, update-initramfs or mkinitcpio). The theme is chosen, but it will not show at boot until you rebuild the initramfs.
steps.noDisplay: There is no graphical session: the preview needs X11 or Wayland.
steps.missing: The program {arg} is missing. Install it to be able to do this.
steps.xephyrFailed: The test screen (Xephyr) could not be opened.
steps.captureFailed: The picture of the preview could not be taken.

errors.title: Could not be completed
errors.apply: The theme could not be applied.
errors.preview: The theme could not be previewed.
errors.install: The theme could not be installed.
errors.remove: Not all the themes could be removed.
